description: This source file defines a custom Android button class 'AnticiButton' that implements anticipation and follow-through animation effects by skewing and translating the button based on user interactions and animations.

classes.name: AnticiButton
classes.description: A custom button subclass that implements anticipation and follow-through animations using skew and translation transformations to simulate realistic motion effects.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the button by setting up touch and click listeners.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Overrides the draw method to apply skew transformations to the canvas before drawing the button.

methods.name: runPressAnim
methods.description: Starts the anticipation skew animation when the button is pressed.

methods.name: runClickAnim
methods.description: Performs a sequence of animations: sliding the button, skewing for overshoot, and wobbling back to neutral.

methods.name: runCancelAnim
methods.description: Reverts the button to its normal state, cancelling any ongoing anticipation animations.

methods.name: getSkewX
methods.description: Returns the current skew factor applied on the X-axis.

methods.name: setSkewX
methods.description: Sets the skew amount and invalidates the view to trigger a redraw.
